question.text: Per the general SEBI/AMFI timeline supported by the Series II-B workbook, within how many working days from receipt of a valid redemption request should the redemption cheque or proceeds be dispatched/paid?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Series II-B workbook (pages 186 and 192) states that redemption proceeds or redemption/repurchase cheques are to be paid or dispatched within 3 working days from the receipt of a valid transaction request, i.e. T+3 working days. For overseas funds, the timeline is 5 business days. The Trap: Candidates may apply other settlement cycles from the equity market or from different scheme categories. The Series II-B workbook pages checked support the T+3 working-day timeline for redemption payouts generally. Note: The RTA's processing workflow is designed to support this 3-working-day dispatch standard from the receipt of the redemption request.
